metadata.query:
// Raw ERROR log samples of one lab service in a window (bounded).
fetch logs, from:"2026-09-19T08:26:57.691Z", to:"2026-09-19T08:27:01.889Z"
| filter service.namespace == "easytrade-otel-lab" and service.name == "broker-service"
| filter loglevel == "ERROR"
| fields timestamp, loglevel, status, service.name, service.namespace, deployment.environment.name, trace_id, span_id, otel.scope.name, exception.type, exception.message, content
| sort timestamp asc
| limit 20
